title: Comprehensive Postpartum Care Strategy for Medicaid Populations
implementation_guidance: Implement a multi-component postpartum care strategy that includes: 1) Schedule the first postpartum visit within 1-2 weeks after delivery, rather than waiting for the traditional 6-week visit; 2) Use reminder systems including text messages, phone calls, and mail notifications to improve attendance; 3) Conduct comprehensive screenings at postpartum visits including depression (using PHQ-9), anxiety, substance use, intimate partner violence, and social determinants of health; 4) Provide contraceptive counseling and same-day access to contraceptive methods of choice; 5) Assess breastfeeding status and provide lactation support or referrals as needed; 6) Screen for chronic conditions that may have developed during pregnancy (hypertension, diabetes) and establish appropriate follow-up care; 7) Coordinate care with pediatric providers to align maternal postpartum visits with infant well-visits; 8) Implement flexible scheduling options including evening and weekend appointments; 9) Offer telehealth options when appropriate for follow-up care; 10) Address transportation barriers through ride-sharing services or transportation vouchers; 11) Provide culturally and linguistically appropriate education materials on postpartum warning signs and when to seek care; 12) Establish a system to track patients who miss appointments and conduct outreach.
expected_outcomes: Increased postpartum visit attendance rates, improved identification and management of postpartum complications, reduced emergency department utilization, increased contraceptive uptake, improved breastfeeding continuation rates, better management of chronic conditions, reduced postpartum depression, improved patient satisfaction with care, reduced racial disparities in postpartum care utilization.
target_population: Medicaid-enrolled individuals in the postpartum period, particularly those from racial and ethnic minority groups and those facing barriers to accessing care.
citation: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services. Resources on Strategies to Improve Postpartum Care Among Medicaid and CHIP Populations. https://www.medicaid.gov/medicaid/quality-of-care/downloads/strategies-to-improve-postpartum-care.pdf. Published February 2015. Accessed May 29, 2025.
